risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
series is close to noise; fitted weights would overfit
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~15% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The spectrum is close to white noise, so most of the variation is irregular and hard to predict. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.259), which favours a robust combination.

attempts.rationale: The series shows very high trend and seasonality but ranking is unstable, so a robust weighted combination is a good first test.
Test a simple robust mean over the full model pool to see if averaging improves over weighted softmax.
test a weighted combination on the full pool using inverse_error to see if including weaker models helps; ranking is unstable so robust weighting may improve.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust weighted combination over the full pool with a softmax‑negative‑error weighting may better handle the variability.
The series has strong trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean over the full pool may reduce influence of outliers.
The series has unstable rankings; a robust weighted combo over the top 11 models (pool4) might outperform the full pool weighted by inverse_error.
ranking is unstable and several models are correlated; a robust DBA on the stable pool4 may improve over weighted inverse_error.
Test a per‑horizon weighted combination on the full pool using the best_per_horizon weights (w6) to see if horizon‑specific selection improves over the DBA baseline.
The series has strong trend/seasonality but unstable rankings; a robust median on the full pool may outperform weighted combos.
The series has unstable rankings and strong correlation groups; a robust DBA on the full pool may outperform weighted combos.
Explore a per‑horizon weighted scheme on the stable pool4 to capture horizon‑specific strengths amid unstable rankings.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.91. Series context: trend strength 0.9999 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.259); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.457.
